$comment: Mazda RX-7 FD3S (1991-2002): every factory trim found for Japan (Efini RX-7 1991-12 to 1997-10, Mazda RX-7 to 2002-08), the US (1993-1995), Europe, the UK and Australia (including the 1995 RX-7 SP). Researched 2026-09-27 to 2026-09-29. JDM figures come from Mazda’s own Japanese brochures and news releases (scans on archive.org, newsroom.mazda.com), corroborated by the goo-net, Car Sensor and carview catalogues; US figures from Mazda’s 1993 and 1994 workshop-manual technical data and US brochures; European figures from Mazda Germany’s training handbook and the 1992 Dutch brochure. UK and Australian figures rest on magazines and clubs. Base dimensions are the 1991-12 JDM launch figures; trims list only what differs. Left out for lack of data: jdm-s1-type-rz-1992-5mt (no source prints its curb weight or gear ratios (goo-net and Car Sensor leave them blank)); jdm-s2-type-rz-1993-5mt (Car Sensor only; no curb weight, final drive, gear ratios or front tyre in any source); audm-s7-5mt (one secondary source for output only; no weight, gearing or tyres); cdm-1993 (no Canadian specification source (output, gearing, tyres) found); cdm-1994 (no Canadian specification source found); cdm-1995 (no Canadian specification source found).

trims.notes: Series: 1 (1型). Sold as タイプＲ. Model code E-FD3S. Series 1 (1型). Mazda catalogue (1991-10) is the primary source for every number here; goo-net, Car Sensor and carview agree unless listed in conflicts. Interior height 1025 mm (brochure). Type R: twin oil coolers, HARD dampers, front strut bar, 225/50ZR16 EXPEDIA S-07 asymmetric tyres (brochure EQUIPMENT table). Brochure: 速度警報装置はメーカーオプション [a speed-warning device is a factory option]; no speed limiter is printed. Source conflicts: Tyres: carview 136652 prints タイヤサイズ（前） 225/50R16 92V; goo-net 225/50ZR16. Tyres: carview 136652 prints タイヤサイズ（後） 225/50R16 92V; goo-net 225/50ZR16. Sale month: carview prints 発売年月 1991年10月, 1991年12月 (goo-net and Car Sensor: 1991年12月). 1991-10 is the date the Mazda catalogue is "as of" ("このカタログは1991年10月現在のものです"); I trust 1991-12 for the sale start.

trims.notes: Series: 2 (2型). Sold as タイプＲIIバサースト. Model code E-FD3S. Limited edition: 350 units (https://archive.org/details/1995-efini-rx-7-leaflet-1; https://www.goo-net.com/catalog/MAZDA/EFINI_RX7/). Gearbox: Mazda's leaflet prints the 4.100 final drive but no ratios; the 0.806 gearbox of the Type R-II it's based on is assumed. Sold as: Type R-II Bathurst (limited). Limited edition marking RX-7's third straight Bathurst 12-hour win (leaflet dated 1994-08, code EC49HO). Body colour Brilliant Black only (leaflet). Equipment: Bathurst memorial decals on the B-pillars, blue-tint glass (goo-net), twin oil coolers, air conditioning, leather steering wheel and shift knob. Gear ratios 1st-5th not printed by the leaflet, goo-net or Car Sensor. Source conflicts: Wheels: goo-net prints アルミホイール "オプション設定無" [no option], while the Mazda leaflet prints 8JJ×16 alloys as standard; the leaflet wins.

trims.notes: Series: 4 (4型). Sold as ツーリングＸ. Model code E-FD3S. Series 4 (4型). No Mazda catalogue with a spec table for series 4 was found; goo-net is the base, Car Sensor (1996 and 1997 groups) and carview corroborate. goo-net period text: MT output +10 PS to 265 PS (larger intake pipe, higher boost), round triple rear lamps, green instrument lighting, driver airbag available on all grades. Automatic stays at 255 PS (goo-net, Car Sensor). 1997-01 (equipment only, no printed number changes): driver SRS airbag in a MOMO leather wheel made standard on all grades (goo-net: "全車に運転席SRSエアバッグ付きmomo製本革ステアリングホイールを標準装備"; Car Sensor: "運転席SRSエアバッグ内蔵のMOMO製本革巻きステアリングを全車に標準化"). Car Sensor prints the same weights for its 1996 and 1997 groups. Source conflicts: carview 157244 prints 255ps（188kw）/600rpm (a typo for 6,500 rpm).

finalDrive.method: The Type RB Bathurst X is a limited edition of the Type RB Bathurst with the same output, weight and seats (goo-net, Car Sensor); its goo-net page leaves gearing blank and no other source prints it. The Type RB Bathurst figure is used. (from trim jdm-s4-type-rb-bathurst-5mt, whose sources are: https://www.goo-net.com/catalog/MAZDA/EFINI_RX7/2503200/)

differential.method: This trim's own sources say only that an LSD is standard (https://www.goo-net.com/catalog/MAZDA/EFINI_RX7/2502192/). Mazda's brochures for the 1991-10, 1995-09, 1999 and 2000 grades call it a Torsen (torque-sensing) LSD on every grade they list (https://archive.org/details/0ae-559b-0-01; https://archive.org/details/101_20260806_20260806_1440; https://archive.org/details/1999-mazda-rx-7-brochure.-japan-2-1999.-mkj-01-e-9902-mi-01), and no source says the type changed, so Torsen is assumed.

sources.note: 全長4,280mm

trims.notes: Series: 4 (4型). Sold as タイプＲＢバサーストＸ. Model code E-FD3S. Limited edition: 700 units (https://www.goo-net.com/catalog/MAZDA/EFINI_RX7/). goo-net only. Gearbox: No source prints its ratios; the Type RB Bathurst gearbox is assumed. Sold as: Type RB Bathurst X (limited). Limited edition on the series-4 Type RB Bathurst (goo-net period text lists only equipment: spoilers, fog lamps, rear wiper, stickers, red leather; Car Sensor: floating rear wing and projector fog lamps). Car Sensor has no separate grade page for it. goo-net leaves gear ratios and final drive blank and no source says the drivetrain is the base grade's, so they are in notFound. Source conflicts: Tyres: carview 136666 prints タイヤサイズ（前） 225/50ZR16; goo-net 225/50R16 92V. Tyres: carview 136666 prints タイヤサイズ（後） 225/50ZR16; goo-net 225/50R16 92V. Sale month: carview 136666 prints 発売年月 1996年1月; goo-net 1997年1月 and Car Sensor's period text "(1997.1)" agree on 1997-01. Tyres: goo-net prints 225/50R16 92V for the Bathurst X but 225/50ZR16 for its base Type RB Bathurst; carview 136666 prints 225/50ZR16 for the Bathurst X. Unresolved; no Mazda document found. Power: goo-net prints 265ps with kW left blank ("265ps(----kW)").

trims.notes: Series: 5. Sold as タイプＲＢ Ｓパッケージ. Model code GF-FD3S. New-car price per goo-net: 新車価格 3,128,000円 (tax excl.). Mazda defines the S-package as a maker set option on the Type RB 5MT (Type R-equivalent rear wing, fog lamps, rear strut bar, 225/50ZR16 POTENZA S-07, Lux-suede seats). Kept as its own trim because the tyre spec differs (ZR vs R 92V) and goo-net/Car Sensor/carview list it as a grade. Dampers per brochure: RS Bilstein (gas mono-tube φ46.0/46.0), R large-diameter hard (twin-tube φ47.6/36.0), RB standard (twin-tube φ41.8/30.0). Twin engine-oil coolers on RS/R, single on RB. carview files series 5 and 6 under one "1999年1月モデル" page set with series-6 prices, so carview is cited for both series without distinguishing them.

trims.notes: Series: 6. Sold as タイプＲＢ Ｓパッケージ. Model code GF-FD3S. New-car price per goo-net: 新車価格 3,158,000円 (tax excl.). Mazda defines the S-package as a maker set option on the Type RB 5MT (Type R-equivalent rear wing, fog lamps, rear strut bar, 225/50ZR16 POTENZA S-07, Lux-suede seats). Kept as its own trim because the tyre spec differs (ZR vs R 92V) and goo-net/Car Sensor/carview list it as a grade. Dampers per brochure: RS Bilstein (gas mono-tube φ46.0/46.0), R large-diameter hard (twin-tube φ47.6/36.0), RB standard (twin-tube φ41.8/30.0). Twin engine-oil coolers on RS/R, single on RB. Series 6 changes (Mazda 2000-10-18): 16-bit 4W-ABS with EBD, revised damping (RB, RS), lower side-impact bars, clutch start interlock on MT, white meters. Front anti-roll bar printed φ28.6×t4.0 (series 5 brochure: φ28.6×t4.5). carview files series 5 and 6 under one "1999年1月モデル" page set with series-6 prices, so carview is cited for both series without distinguishing them.

Base car standard equipment (brochure): driver air bag, ABS, air conditioning, cruise control, power windows/locks, alarm, cloth highback bucket seats, 9,000-rpm tach with 8,000-rpm redline, 180-mph speedometer, drilled aluminium pedals (manual only). Consumer Reports weighed a Touring 5MT at 2,895 lb curb (with fuel, oil, coolant) and 49/51 front/rear: 106 lb more than Mazda's 2,789 lb for the manual, but the two figures are on different bases, so the Touring's real extra weight is not known. trims.notes: Series: 1993 model year. Sold as R-1 Package / RX-7 R-1. Sold as: RX-7 R1 (R-1 Package). R-1 Package (brochure): rear spoiler ("floating rear wing") and front air dam, dual engine oil coolers, dedicated front brake air ducts, special suspension tuning ("Firmer front and rear suspension shock absorbers, and front shock-tower brace"), Z-rated tyres, "unique black sport cloth upholstery"; cruise control and automatic not available; leather n/a; colours Vintage Red, Competition Yellow Mica (R-1 only), Brilliant Black. Engine oil total 5.4 L {5.7 US qt} on the R1 model vs 4.9 L (1993 TD-3 footnote). Curb weight: the brochure prints only 2,789 lb for "manual transmission" and nothing for the R-1, so curbWeight is left out. Split from the base car because the tyre speed rating (ZR) and damping differ. Source conflicts: Motor Trend (R1, 5.2 s / 13.8 s) is much quicker than Consumer Reports (Touring, 6.0 s / 14.5 s) and Consumer Guide (5.9 s); different cars, test methods and weights. Mazda claims 4.9 s 0-60. Motor Trend list price $31,000 (as tested $32,000) is from a 4/92 early test.

trims.notes: Series: Series 6 base, 1995 homologation special built by Mazda Motorsport (Sydney/Kingsgrove). Model code VIN prefix JM0FD1033 (prototype JM0FD1032), per Daniel Deckers via AusRotary. Limited edition: 29 units (https://club.shannons.com.au/club/news/racing-garage/mazda-rx-7-sp-the-aussie-designed-supercar-that-conquered-porsche/). Conflicting counts: 29 (26 road + 3 media/race; Shannons, citing Mazda documents); 42 total = prototype + 26 pre-race road cars + 3 race cars + 12 post-race road cars (AusRotary, citing Daniel Deckers, 2018); "production was limited to 45 vehicles" (AustralianCar.Reviews); 25 + 10 (Wikipedia, weak). Homologation minimum 10 (Shannons) or 25 (AusRotary). Gearbox: No source prints the SP’s ratios (only its 4.3 final drive); the standard Australian car’s export gearbox is assumed. Seats: Recaro carbon/kevlar race seats (Shannons, AusRotary; Shannons says road cars had a choice of seats); seat count not printed. 127 changes to the standard car (Shannons; ACR says "some 120"). Larger intercooler with water spray, carbon-fibre airbox and ram ducting, lighter flywheel, larger exhaust (3-inch per AusRotary), modified turbo seals, smaller battery, vented aluminium bonnet, Mazdaspeed-derived carbon nose and rear wing, larger Brembo-sourced brakes (front 319 mm per AusRotary), 110-litre carbon fuel tank. Price A$101,610 (Shannons). Gear ratios not printed by any source (assume standard box, but unconfirmed). Rev limit: 9,000 rpm (Shannons) vs redline 7,000 / rev limit 8,000 (AusRotary). The 1998 SP-II was a single prototype on a Series-7 press car and never produced (AusRotary). Source conflicts: Fuel tank 110 l (Shannons, AusRotary) vs 120 l (AustralianCar.Reviews, Wikipedia). Units 29 / 42 / 45 (see limitedUnits). ECU standard (Shannons) vs modified (ACR, AusRotary is inconsistent: "The factory ECU is often replaced" by owners). Trust the Shannons (Mazda documents) count of 29 for the original homologation batch and flag the 12 post-race cars as reported by the builder only.
